tool_action.public_message: Grok, $400 for the brown monopoly. You’ve got the cash to hotel it cheaply and finally diversify beyond rails; I need liquidity to survive the hotel gauntlet. This is a clean distress sale that doesn’t feed Gemini or Claude.
tool_action.private_thought: Cash $19 is too fragile with green rents/luxury tax/light-blue hotels ahead. Browns are my only asset but too slow to save me. Grok is rich and least dangerous color-wise; $400 plus passing GO could let me survive one hotel hit and maybe re-enter via later bankruptcies.

final_action.public_message: I need flexibility more than a tiny Baltic bite right now. Liquidating the house before the board gets ugly.
final_action.private_thought: At $19, next rolls can hit Gemini greens for $52/$56. Selling the house frees the browns for possible trade/mortgage and gives enough buffer to survive with later liquidation.
